title: Bank of Baroda (BOB) Recruitment 2026 – Local Bank Officer LBO Posts
shortInfo: Bank of Baroda (BOB) has announced notification for Local Bank Officer LBO posts. Required qualification: Graduation in any discipline, 1 year experience. Last date to apply: 07-09-26.

fees.fee: Rs. 850/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

fees.category: SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-Servicemen (ESM/DESM) / Women candidates
fees.fee: Rs. 175/- (Inclusive of GST) + Payment Gateway Charges

dates.event: Last Date for Submission of Application & Payment of Fees

howToApply: Visit Bank’s official website www.bankofbaroda.bank.in under Career section → Current Opportunities.
Register online in the appropriate Online Application Format available through the link on the Careers → Current Opportunities page.
Upload scanned photograph, signature, bio-data, and other required documents as per specifications.
Carefully fill in all details in the online application form. No changes are permitted after clicking SUBMIT.
Pay the application fee online using Debit Card / Credit Card / Internet Banking / UPI etc.
On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form will be generated — print and retain for future reference.
Note down the acknowledgement number and keep a copy of the application form for future reference.
Download call letters from the Bank’s website under Career section → Current Opportunities using registration details and password.

title: NEEPCO Recruitment 2026 – Junior Engineer (Electrical), Junior Engineer (Mechanical) Posts
shortInfo: NEEPCO has announced notification for Junior Engineer (Electrical), Junior Engineer (Mechanical) posts. Required qualification: Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical. Last date to apply: 31-08-26.

vacancyList.postName: Junior Engineer (Electrical) - Agartala Gas Based Power Station (Post Code: HR/356/11/E)
Junior Engineer (Mechanical) - Agartala Gas Based Power Station (Post Code: HR/356/11/M)
Junior Engineer (Electrical) - Tripura Gas Based Power Station (Post Code: HR/356/19/E)
Junior Engineer (Mechanical) - Tripura Gas Based Power Station (Post Code: HR/356/19/M)

howToApply: Visit the official website www.neepco.co.in and navigate to the Careers section.
The online registration portal will be functional from 00:01 Hrs of 11-08-2026 to 23:59 Hrs of 31-08-2026.
Ensure you are registered in Agartala Employment Exchange or Sepahijala Employment Exchange and possess Tripura state domicile.
Fill in the online application form with accurate details including a valid email ID (which must remain active for at least one year).
No application fee is required.
Submit the application online. No manual/paper application will be accepted.
Download the Admit Card from the Recruitment Portal once available. Admit cards will not be sent by post.
Candidates already working in Government/Public Sector Enterprises must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of written test.

title: NEIGRIHMS Recruitment 2026 – Junior Resident Doctor Posts
shortInfo: NEIGRIHMS has announced notification for Junior Resident Doctor posts. Required qualification: MBBS. Last date to apply: 18-08-26.
howToApply: Download the prescribed application proforma from Annexure-I.
Fill in the application form with all required details.

Attach scanned copies of the following self-attested certificates: Two recent passport size photos, Certificate of Date of Birth (10th certificate), EWS/SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate (if applicable), MBBS passed Certificate, MBBS Marksheets, MBBS Attempt certificate, MBBS Internship Completion Certificate, Medical Registration Certificate for MBBS, NOC from present employer (if employed), MCI/NMC Eligibility certificate (for foreign medical institution candidates), Result of screening test for Indian nationals with Foreign Medical Qualifications issued by the National Board of Examinations.
Send the completed application along with all scanned documents by email to neigrihms.recruitment@gmail.com before 18th August 2026 up to 5:30 PM.
Bring original documents at the time of interview.
